title: Find array minimum and maximum reference solution
answer:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void) { int a[]={7,-2,9,4}; size_t n=sizeof a/sizeof a[0]; int lo=a[0],hi=a[0]; for(size_t i=1;i<n;++i) { if(a[i]<lo) lo=a[i]; if(a[i]>hi) hi=a[i]; } printf("min=%d max=%d\n",lo,hi); return 0; }
